notes: Dahua's official RTSP URL format is /cam/realmonitor?channel=<N>&subtype=<typeNo>. Channel numbering starts at 1. subtype: 0=main stream, 1=extra stream 1 (sub), 2=extra stream 2 (third stream). Default RTSP port is 554 and may be omitted if unchanged. Both basic and digest authentication are supported (credentials embedded in the URL as rtsp://{user}:{pass}@{ip}:{port}/...). The `unicast=true&proto=Onvif` query params seen in some leads are optional ONVIF-layer hints, not required by the base RTSP URL. Many budget brands (realmonitor OEMs) share this exact URL scheme — confirm via brand's own docs before attributing. The leads with hardcoded base64 `authbasic=` values are device-specific credential injections, not a Dahua URL schema feature.
